```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(TTR)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
boeing_data <- read.csv("Boeing.csv")

head(boeing_data)
```

```{r}
# Convert the Date column to Date format
boeing_data$Date <- as.Date(boeing_data$Date, format="%Y-%m-%d")

# Calculate Daily Returns as a percentage
boeing_data <- boeing_data %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(Daily_Return = (Close - lag(Close)) / lag(Close) * 100)

# Calculate 7-day and 30-day moving averages for the Close prices
boeing_data <- boeing_data %>%
  mutate(MA_7 = rollmean(Close, 7, fill = NA, align = "right"),
         MA_30 = rollmean(Close, 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))

# Calculate 7-day and 30-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns as volatility measures
boeing_data <- boeing_data %>%
  mutate(Volatility_7 = rollapply(Daily_Return, 7, sd, fill = NA, align = "right"),
         Volatility_30 = rollapply(Daily_Return, 30, sd, fill = NA, align = "right"))

# Cumulative Returns
boeing_data <- boeing_data %>%
  mutate(Daily_Return = replace_na(Daily_Return, 0)) %>%  
  mutate(Cumulative_Return = cumprod(1 + Daily_Return / 100) - 1)


#Relative Strength Indes(RSI)
boeing_data$RSI_14 <- RSI(boeing_data$Close, n = 14)

#Exponential Moving Average (EMA)
boeing_data$EMA_7 <- EMA(boeing_data$Close, n = 7)
boeing_data$EMA_30 <- EMA(boeing_data$Close, n = 30)

# View the first few rows of the data to check the calculations
head(boeing_data)
```

```{r}
# Meeting 
# Profile Plot
# Closing Price Over Time
ggplot(boeing_data, aes(x = Date, y = Close)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Boeing Closing Price Over Time", x = "Date", y = "Closing Price")


# Volatility Over Time
ggplot(boeing_data, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Volatility_7, color = "7-Day Volatility")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Volatility_30, color = "30-Day Volatility")) +
  labs(title = "Boeing Stock Volatility Over Time", x = "Date", y = "Volatility") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("7-Day Volatility" = "purple", "30-Day Volatility" = "darkred"))

```

```{r}
# Meeting 
# Empirical Summary Plot
# Histogram of Daily Returns
ggplot(boeing_data, aes(x = Daily_Return)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Daily Returns", x = "Daily Return (%)", y = "Frequency")

# Histogram of 7-Day Volatility
ggplot(boeing_data, aes(x = Volatility_7)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "lightcoral", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of 7-Day Volatility", x = "7-Day Volatility", y = "Frequency")

```

```{r}
# Meeting 
# Fit a linear model predicting Daily_Return
model <- lm(Daily_Return ~ Volume + MA_7 + RSI_14, data = boeing_data)

# Output the summary of the model
summary(model)
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Import the datasets
boeing_data <- read.csv("Boeing.csv")
airbus_data <- read.csv("Airbus.csv")
lmt_data <- read.csv("LMT.csv")

# Standardize column names and add a "Stock" column
boeing_data <- boeing_data %>%
  rename(Price = Close) %>%  # Rename Close to Price
  mutate(Stock = "Boeing")

airbus_data <- airbus_data %>%
  rename(Price = Close) %>%  # Rename Close to Price
  mutate(Stock = "Airbus")

lmt_data <- lmt_data %>%
  rename(Price = Close) %>%  # Rename Close to Price
  mutate(Stock = "Lockheed Martin")

# Combine all datasets into one
stock_data <- bind_rows(boeing_data, airbus_data, lmt_data)

# Ensure the Date column is in date format
stock_data$Date <- as.Date(stock_data$Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Filter and prepare the data for plotting
stock_data <- stock_data %>%
  filter(Stock %in% c("Boeing", "Airbus", "Lockheed Martin")) %>%
  mutate(Stock = factor(Stock, levels = c("Boeing", "Airbus", "Lockheed Martin")))

# Create time-series plot using linewidth (for ggplot2 >= 3.4.0)
ggplot(stock_data, aes(x = Date, y = Price, color = Stock)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Time-Series Plot of Stock Prices (2019-2024)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Stock Price",
    color = "Company"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")



```
